ways.title: Ways to pay
ways.stripe: Pay by card and other ways
ways.stripeSub: Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and more, on the secure Stripe page
ways.noteStripe: You'll pay on the Stripe page. This shop never sees your card.
ways.notePaypal: You'll pay on the PayPal page. This shop never sees your card.
ways.noteBoth: You'll pay on the Stripe or PayPal page. This shop never sees your card.

redirect.title: Taking you to {provider}…
redirect.notArabic: The Stripe page is not in Arabic.

checking.title: Checking with {provider}…
checking.body: This takes a few seconds. You can close this page; the shop will still get your payment.
checking.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can close this page; the shop will still get your payment.

paid.title: Thank you. Your payment of {amount} arrived.
paid.receiptAsk: Ask {shop} if you need a receipt.
paid.receiptSent: A receipt is on its way to your email.

processing.title: Your bank is confirming it
processing.withMethod: A payment of {amount} by {method} was started on {date}. Your bank confirms it in a few working days. You don't need to pay again.
processing.plain: A payment of {amount} was started on {date}. Your bank confirms it in a few working days. You don't need to pay again.

failed.title: The payment did not go through.

cancelled.title: You left the payment page before paying.
cancelled.stripe: You left the Stripe page before paying.
cancelled.paypal: You left the PayPal page before paying.

shopChecks.title: The shop will check this payment
shopChecks.body: We received a payment, but it does not match the amount due. The shop will look at it and write to you.

retryLater: Open the pay link again to try once more.

nothingDue.title: There is nothing to pay here yet.

voided.title: This can no longer be paid here.

locked.title: Too many payment tries on this link.
locked.bodyBank: Please try again in an hour, or pay by bank transfer.
locked.body: Please try again in an hour.

noWays.title: There is no way to pay this amount online here.

unavailable.title: {shop} cannot take payments online right now.

testStaffOnly.title: This test link opens only for the staff of {shop}.
testStaffOnly.body: Sign in to the dashboard in this browser, then open the link again.

offline.title: This page could not reach the shop.
offline.body: Check your connection and try again.

proofFailed: The check that you are a person did not pass. Try again.

bank.title: Bank transfer
bank.note: Use this reference so the shop can find your payment. It shows as paid once the shop has checked.
bank.noAccount: Ask {shop} for its bank details for this currency.

cash.title: Pay when it arrives
cash.plain: Pay the amount due when your order arrives.

demo.title: Demo payment service
demo.staff: Staff only. A pretend payment service: no money moves and no card is needed.
demo.needsStep: Pay: the bank asks for a step
demo.gone: This demo payment cannot be continued. Go back to the pay page.
